_comment: Objective product facts curated from each broker's public pages. collection_method is 'manual_curation': values were read from public pages and entered by hand with the URL recorded; the broker_sites collector re-verifies them over time. Volatile values (yields, margin rates) carry an as_of_date and medium confidence — the scoring engine applies staleness penalties. Levels: fractional_shares_scope 0=none 1=partial 2=stocks+ETFs; banking_level 0=none..3=full checking/ATM; security_level 0..2; tax_lot_control 0=FIFO only,1=limited,2=full spec-ID.
